## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector participation (9/11) vs. material large-cap divergences among mega-caps (MSFT, INTC, ORCL, PANW BELOW TREND) — mixed signals support NEUTRAL. Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +6.78% | 1M: +0.16%) ABOVE TREND and steady; Energy strong: OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +11.40%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples weakest: WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION, EL (1W: +7.34% | 1M: -3.09%) RECOVERY. Materials weak: NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare showing limited upside: JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors in Top 5); style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -18.06%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -4.37% | 1M: -27.50%) BELOW TREND, NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Technology and Materials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +14.45%), SHOP (1W: +14.04%), OXY (1W: +13.96%), DE (1W: +10.76%), GE (1W: +9.69%) — note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple large caps (AMZN, GOOGL, UNH, PYPL) showing RECOVERY (1W up / 1M down), implying tactical rebounds rather than confirmed trend flips.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed. AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND provide leadership while MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND create dispersion; Tech breadth: internal rotation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Cautiously constructive. JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND anchors strength but key payments names like V (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND show unevenness; Financials breadth: internal rotation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mixed/defensive. JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION and PFE (1W: -2.99% | 1M: +4.66%) CORRECTION show headline-driven moves while LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND limits sector upside; Healthcare breadth: internal rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals/value exposure (DE, OXY, GE, AMAT) given leadership and broad sector participation; reduce exposure to lagging large-cap tech names showing confirmed BELOW TREND (INTC, ORCL, PANW). Monitor RECOVERY setups (AMZN, GOOGL, PYPL) as tactical opportunities, not core trend confirmations.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PANW (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -18.06%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Industrials (breadth strong, DE, GE above trend) and Energy (OXY, CVX ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples showing relative weakness and headline sensitivity.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
AMAT near extension — watch consolidation above recent breakout (1W/1M momentum). DE continuation above recent highs (ABOVE TREND) would confirm cyclical leadership. NVDA support/confirm at recent pullback levels while MSFT breaking below 1M trend would increase downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
DE (+80): upbeat earnings/guidance; DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. JNJ (+85): FDA breakthrough for cancer drug; JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION — bullish news but short-term pullback (divergence). PFE (+55): positive trial results; PFE (1W: -2.99% | 1M: +4.66%) CORRECTION — sentiment constructive but price short-term soft.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
V (-50): antitrust headwinds; V (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned. BA (-50): JV troubles headline; BA (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -7.21%) BELOW TREND — confirmed weakness. EL (-50): downgrade headline; EL (1W: +7.34% | 1M: -3.09%) RECOVERY — bearish headlines but short-term rebound (divergence).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Industrials and Energy leadership. DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (AMZN, GOOGL, UNH, PYPL RECOVERY vs. MSFT/INTC/ORCL BELOW TREND) and mixed headline flow (JNJ/PFE positive, SBUX/V negative).
